 Brooks Nader says this ‘two-in-one’ skin care superhero gets her face ‘snatched’ in seconds 
 By 
 Erica Radol 
 Published 
 Nov. 16, 2026, 10:14 a.m. ET 
 See more of our coverage in your search results. 
 Make Page Six a Preferred Source 
 Brooks Nader's favorite serum is an iconic multitasker. 
 brooks nader/ instagram

 That model glow, bottled.
 Brooks Nader hasn’t been shy about her “favorite” skin care, sharing on social media multiple times that she’s hooked on Clarins Double Serum .
 In one GRWM-style TikTok , the model says even when her skin is dry and stressed, the 2-in-1 formula hydrates while “helping with fine lines and wrinkles.” 
 The botanical-rich cult favorite is designed to target all signs of aging. The formula’s been optimized over the years and also helps to firm, boost radiance and refine pores, in addition to strengthening the skin’s moisture barrier.
 Clarins Double Serum 
 Clarins 
 BUY NOW $96.00+ 
 Double Serum also targets the visible effects of environmental and lifestyle aggressors, such as pollution, diet and lack of sleep.
 To apply, the “Love Thy Nader” star warms the serum in her hands before pressing it into her face.
 Nader notes that it requires pressure to encourage lymphatic drainage and help diminish puffiness — a very French technique, which she says gets her “snatched.”
 Brooks Nader applies the Double Serum in a GRWM TikTok, saying it gives her skin a glow. brooks nader/ tiktok 
 Another beauty hack the “Baywatch” star shared? She also applies a little Double Serum on top of her makeup.
 The brand partner said in another social media post that she puts some on her cheeks and nose to increase radiance, saying, “I like the glow that it gives you.”
 Brooks Nader showed off her radiant skin in Cannes last month. / SplashNews.com 
 The reality TV star joins thousands of devotees in loving the lightweight serum , which sinks in immediately.
 “[I] have been using Clarins for close to three months and have noticed a considerable reduction in wrinkles and my skin looking well moisturized,” reads one review.
 “My 60-year-old skin looks and feels fantastic,” wrote another fan. 
 If you’re looking for a new beauty buy to keep skin supple through the cooler months, why not give it a try?
